# External validation of the 20 m maps (internal)

Auto-generated by `scripts/lu20/08_external.py`. Maps: year models, `outputs/lu20/maps/landuse_<y>_20m_year.tif`. Map-to-map comparisons are agreement between two imperfect maps (intercomparison), not accuracy; the accuracy statement is section 1, where every map is scored on the same hand-labelled points.

## 1. Same hand-labelled points (n = 313, confidence <= 2), every map scored the same way

Stratum-weighted (Stehman 2014) macro-F1; 95% stratified bootstrap. Land-cover maps cannot separate residential from non-residential, so the comparison is on built / water / trees / open, and on built vs not built.

## 5. Residential vs non-residential against Overture Places (POIs, independent of OSM)

162,567 places inside HMDA (category fields used: ['basic_category', 'taxonomy']). Of our built cells in 2023, 48.1% are non-residential. Lift = how often POIs of a kind sit in our non-residential cells, divided by what is expected. 'Within own 1 km zone' (the fair test) uses the non-residential share of built land in the POI's own zone as the expectation; the HMDA-wide version is confounded because POIs cluster in the dense core, where the map is mostly residential. A correct split gives lifts above 1 for non-residential POI kinds and below 1 for residential POIs. Overture is a 2026 snapshot scored against the 2023 map, and many Hyderabad shops are on residential plots, so lifts are conservative. Interval: 95%, bootstrap over 12 km blocks.

| POI group | POIs | in built cells | in our non-res (of built) | lift vs HMDA-wide share | lift within own 1 km zone | lo | hi |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| industrial | 2885 | 0.983 | 0.393 | 0.816 | 0.900 | 0.839 | 1.016 |
| office / business | 22866 | 0.979 | 0.363 | 0.754 | 0.889 | 0.854 | 0.937 |
| institutional | 27118 | 0.981 | 0.320 | 0.665 | 0.862 | 0.821 | 0.918 |
| retail / food / services | 55375 | 0.989 | 0.326 | 0.677 | 0.876 | 0.826 | 0.972 |
| residential | 72 | 0.958 | 0.261 | 0.542 | 0.598 | 0.175 | 0.995 |
| other / unknown | 54251 | 0.974 | 0.363 | 0.755 | 0.894 | 0.866 | 0.973 |
